video.title: Turn Voice Memos Into Notes
video.script: You record three voice memos a week. But by Friday, you can't remember what any of them were about. Memo Sense fixes that. Paste your transcript, and it pulls out what actually matters: the concrete actions you need to take, the open questions still bugging you, and the themes worth writing down. No account, no friction, runs right in your browser. Try it now.
